svg.aria-description: Parcel events on RabbitMQ: 5 nodes, 4 connections. 3 applications and the 2 channels where they meet: an arrow into a channel sends to it, an arrow out of one receives from it, labelled with the messages. Imported from AsyncAPI.

svg.title: Parcel events on RabbitMQ
svg.desc: Parcel events on RabbitMQ: 5 nodes, 4 connections. 3 applications and the 2 channels where they meet: an arrow into a channel sends to it, an arrow out of one receives from it, labelled with the messages. Imported from AsyncAPI. Nodes: - Tracking API (Version 1.8.2), service - Carrier event worker (Version 1.8.2), service - Webhook sender (Version 1.3.0), service - Messaging: AMQP broker (tracking-rabbitmq.tracking:5672) - carrier.scans, queue - Messaging: AMQP broker - parcel.status (The new status of a parcel, once per change.), queue Connections: - carrier.scans to Carrier event worker: CarrierScan - Carrier event worker to parcel.status: ParcelStatusChanged, ParcelDelivered - Tracking API to carrier.scans: CarrierScan - parcel.status to Webhook sender: ParcelStatusChanged, ParcelDelivered

g.text: The new status of a parcel, once
